title: Hub windows ease in too
why: UI STEP 2b continued. His words: "they are just reallly compelling and smooth". Trader, gamble, bar, looks, trophies, codex, board, news, sector, stage, carry, crate, ops, welcome and terms windows join the shared UI motion layer: 240 ms open with a 16 px rise, 140 ms close, one open and one close sound. Menus only, no raid value touched.
now: The hub windows now ease open and shut.
